story: Nia wanted to water the sunflower, but the tomato seedlings were thirsty. Mr Bell said, “The tap is broken.” The rain barrel held one can of water. Nia said, “I can divide water equally.” She divided water equally between the tomato seedlings and the sunflower. The shade cloth fell. Nia secured the umbrella above the tomato seedlings with the garden tie. She moved the sunflower under the umbrella. Mr Bell said, “I promise to repair the tap tomorrow.” The tomato seedlings and the sunflower stood upright under the umbrella.
